text_block_list.text:
To improve the Umamusume's abilities,
Summer Training Camp has begun today—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I heard that in Japan, people have "pillow fights" at night during training camps, yes!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hard training by day, pillow fights by night.
Japanese training camps are brutal, desu……!
choice_data_list: (It's not like I do this all the time...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But, no problem!!
I am history's first-ever Sprint Horse Girl of the Year!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best at both training and the pillow fight!

And so, our fiery training camp
with Taiki Shuttle began!
